column1: # Equal-token checkpoints of the two main runs, kept for the like-for-like evaluation (user
# 2026-10-25). ambitious: 4096 x 16k = 67.1M tokens / step; conservative: 2048 x 8k = 16.8M, so
# ambitious step k = conservative step 4k. Geometric marks (33.6B, 67B, 134B, ... tokens): ~1 TB
# per pair (613 + 391 GB). The rolling interval of each run must divide its marks (now 50 / 100).
# The MHA runs of October (suite main / run_2; no GQA) are kept as *_mha; the restarted main runs
# are ambitious (LDM, suite main_ldm, 2026-10-28) and conservative (main_gqa).
# conservative 59600 = 1.0T tokens (user 2026-11-01).
# ambitious_v3 (suite main_ldm, arm ambitious_e360_eng80_v3; phase 1 also 67.1M tokens / step) 1400 and
# conservative 10000: the first HF exports of the two (user 2026-11-01). ambitious_v3 1500 + conservative 6000:
# the FLAG downstream suite on MN5 (user 2026-11-01, with the first ambitious run's 2000).
# ambitious_v4_2ph (suite main_mhc4): 2000 for the FLAG subset on MN5 (user 2026-11-02);
# 3000 for the second export/eval (user 2026-11-03); every 1k step up to 1T tokens (~step 15k,
# 67.1M tokens / step) from 2026-11-05 on (user 2026-11-05). 6000, 7000 and 9000 were rotated out
# before they could be linked: they stay listed but are unrecoverable. From step 9815 the run
# continues with attention head dim 256 in ..._v4_2ph_hd256 (same 67.1M tokens / step), so 10000
# and later marks belong to that run dir. 9814 is the last hd128 checkpoint (the widening is applied
# at load from step 9815; the first widened save is 10000), so 9814 belongs to the old lineage and
# 10000 is the hd256 boundary.
# Config switches are kept as before/after pairs (user 2026-11-05): 9789 (last step before the
# 9790 output z-loss / spectral cap ramp) and 9814 (after the z-loss, before the hd256 widening);
# the hd256 side of the widening is 10000. Add the pair to this list when a switch happens.
# 9200 (start of the cap ramp) was rotated out unpinned. 9789 and 9814 are hard-linked from
# ..._hd256/ckpt and ..._v4_2ph/ckpt into ..._v4_2ph/ckpt_eval (the old dir's own copies were
# rotated out); the sources are stable, so the pins are too.
# ambitious_v4_2ph_hd256 14900 = 1.0T tokens (14,900 x 67.1M), the counterpart of conservative 59600 (user 2026-11-07).
# ambitious_v4_2ph_hd256: every 1k step kept from 2026-11-07 on (user: "continue to store a checkpoint every 1k
# steps"), pinned to 30000 for now: 1.1 TB each, ehpc533 scratch 128.8 / 146.5 TB on 11-07; clean up later (user).
# 31000 / 33000-35000 were rotated out unpinned (the list stopped at 30000). User 2026-11-12: "we should really have
# all of these -- enable checkpointing every 1k steps going forward": every 1k from 36000 to the schedule's end, plus
# 35603 (the final save before the broad-session pause, the resume point). ~1.16 TB each, ~6 TB/day at 17 s/step.
# ambitious_v4_ldm (suite main_ldm): 1000 for the first export/eval (user 2026-11-03).
